Multi-sampling associative model

Source: R/model-multi_sampling.R
multi_sampling.Rd

Multi-sampling associative model

Usage

multi_sampling(C, X, B, K = 1)

Arguments

C

Decay

X

Total associative weight to distribute per trial

B

Associative weight to distribute each sample

K

Number of associations to update per word (constraint: B <= X)

Value

An object of class xslMod

Examples

mod <- multi_sampling(C = 1, X = .2, B = .3, K = 1)
xsl_run(mod, get_example_ambiguous_condition())
